## Specification

### Component: Resizable panels

Panels separated by draggable, keyboard-operable dividers; sizes are percentages of the group.

#### Anatomy
```
<ResizablePanelGroup>   <div role="group" class="ui-resizable-group" data-direction data-dragging data-snapping>   (flex, 100% × 100%)
  <ResizablePanel />      <div id class="ui-resizable-panel" data-panel-id data-collapsed style="flex: <size> 1 0px">   (overflow hidden)
  <ResizableHandle />     <div role="separator" tabindex="0" class="ui-resizable-handle" data-direction>
                            optional <span class="ui-resizable-grip"> with a grip-vertical icon
  <ResizablePanel />
```
A handle must be the direct sibling between two panels (neighbours are read from the DOM).

#### Props
- `ResizablePanelGroup`: `direction` (`horizontal` default | `vertical`), `id` (persist key), `onLayout(sizes: number[])`.
- `ResizablePanel`: `defaultSize` (%), `minSize` (0), `maxSize` (100), `collapsible` (false), `collapsedSize` (0), `onResize(size)`, `id`.
- `ResizableHandle`: `withHandle` (grip), `aria-label` (default "Resize panels").

#### Behaviour
- Panels register with the group (lazily read constraints; registration only changes when panels are added/removed). Layout = saved layout if valid, else the default sizes (missing ones share the rest; everything is scaled to total 100). Before hydration, panels render `flex: <defaultSize> 1 0px`.
- Persistence: only when the group has an `id`. Key `ui-resizable:<id>`, value JSON array of sizes (document order). Restored on mount if it has the right length, finite numbers and sums to ~100. Saved when a drag or key press ends. All storage access is in try/catch.
- Pair resize: moving a divider changes only the two adjacent panels (their sum is constant) and respects both panels' min/max. A collapsible panel snaps to `collapsedSize` when its wanted size is below `collapsedSize + (min - collapsedSize) / 2`.
- Pointer: `pointerdown` captures the pointer and focuses the handle; each move recomputes from the start layout: `delta % = pixel delta / total pixel size of panels * 100`. `pointerup`/`cancel` ends the drag and saves. The group gets `data-dragging` (user-select none, col/row-resize cursor).
- Keyboard on the handle: arrows ±5% along the axis (Left/Right for horizontal groups, Up/Down for vertical), Home/End move to the lowest/highest size of the previous panel the neighbours allow, Enter toggles the collapsible neighbour (restoring its previous size, or its minimum).

#### ARIA
- `role="separator"`, `aria-orientation` perpendicular to the group direction (`vertical` for side-by-side panels), `aria-valuenow` = previous panel's size in % (rounded to .01), `aria-valuemin` / `aria-valuemax` = limits that panel can reach given both panels' constraints, `aria-controls` = the previous panel's id.

#### Visual rules
- Handle: 1px line in `--ui-border`; hover `--ui-border-strong`; focus-visible and dragging `--ui-ring` with a 1px ring so it reads as 3px. Invisible hit area 8px (24px on `(pointer: coarse)`). `touch-action: none`.
- Grip: 14×24px (swapped for vertical), `--ui-surface-raised`, 1px border, radius `--radius-sm`, muted icon, rotated 90° for vertical.
- Panels: `min-width/height: 0`, `overflow: hidden`. No shadows.

#### Motion
- Dragging has no easing. While `data-snapping` (keyboard collapse/restore, 700ms) panels transition `flex-grow` on `--ui-spring-smooth`. Reduced motion: instant.

#### Accessibility
- WAI-ARIA window splitter pattern (focusable separator, arrow keys, Home/End, Enter to collapse).
- Pointer capture keeps the drag alive outside the handle; touch hit area enlarged.

#### Acceptance checks
- Default sizes render proportionally (e.g. 20/36/44).
- Dragging a handle by N px changes the neighbours by N / available px; limits are respected.
- ArrowRight on a horizontal handle raises `aria-valuenow` by 5; Home / End reach `aria-valuemin` / `aria-valuemax`.
- Enter collapses and restores a collapsible neighbour.
- With an `id`, a reload restores the layout.
- No serious axe violations in light and dark.

### `ui/components/resizable/layout.ts`

```ts
/** Pure layout math for resizable panels. Sizes are percentages that add up to 100. */

export interface PanelConstraints {
  /** Smallest size when open, in %. */
  min: number;
  /** Largest size, in %. */
  max: number;
  /** May be dragged past half its minimum to snap shut at `collapsedSize`. */
  collapsible: boolean;
  /** Size when collapsed, in %. */
  collapsedSize: number;
}

const EPSILON = 0.05;

export const round = (n: number) => Math.round(n * 100) / 100;

export function isCollapsed(c: PanelConstraints, size: number): boolean {
  return c.collapsible && size <= c.collapsedSize + EPSILON;
}

/** Clamp a wanted size into the panel's range; a collapsible panel snaps shut below half-way to its minimum. */
export function constrainSize(c: PanelConstraints, size: number): number {
  if (c.collapsible && size < c.collapsedSize + (c.min - c.collapsedSize) / 2) return c.collapsedSize;
  return Math.min(c.max, Math.max(c.min, size));
}

/**
 * Move the divider between panel `i` and `i + 1` by `delta` percentage points. Only those two panels
 * change; the result still sums to the same total. If neither panel can absorb the move, the layout is
 * returned unchanged.
 */
export function resizePair(layout: number[], constraints: PanelConstraints[], i: number, delta: number): number[] {
  const pa = constraints[i];
  const pb = constraints[i + 1];
  if (!pa || !pb) return layout;
  const total = layout[i]! + layout[i + 1]!;
  let a = constrainSize(pa, layout[i]! + delta);
  let b = total - a;
  const b2 = constrainSize(pb, b);
  if (Math.abs(b2 - b) > 1e-9) {
    b = b2;
    a = total - b;
    if (Math.abs(constrainSize(pa, a) - a) > 1e-9) return layout;
  }
  const next = layout.slice();
  next[i] = a;
  next[i + 1] = b;
  return next;
}

/** Fill in missing default sizes (they share what is left) and scale everything to total 100. */
export function normalizeLayout(defaults: (number | undefined)[]): number[] {
  const n = defaults.length;
  if (!n) return [];
  const known = defaults.reduce<number>((sum, d) => sum + (d ?? 0), 0);
  const unknown = defaults.filter((d) => d === undefined).length;
  const filled = defaults.map((d) => d ?? Math.max(0, 100 - known) / Math.max(1, unknown));
  const sum = filled.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
  if (sum <= 0) return filled.map(() => 100 / n);
  return filled.map((v) => (v / sum) * 100);
}

/** A stored layout is only reused if it has the right length, finite numbers and totals ~100. */
export function isValidLayout(value: unknown, count: number): value is number[] {
  if (!Array.isArray(value) || value.length !== count) return false;
  if (!value.every((v) => typeof v === 'number' && Number.isFinite(v) && v >= 0)) return false;
  const sum = (value as number[]).reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
  return Math.abs(sum - 100) < 1;
}
```

### `ui/components/resizable/resizable-handle.tsx`

```tsx
'use client';

import { forwardRef, useRef, useState, type HTMLAttributes, type KeyboardEvent, type PointerEvent } from 'react';
import { cn } from '../../lib/cn';
import { useComposedRefs } from '../../lib/compose-refs';
import { Icon } from '../../icons/icon';
import { useIsomorphicLayoutEffect } from '../../hooks/use-isomorphic-layout-effect';
import { useResizableContext, type DragSession, type HandleInfo } from './use-resizable-group';

const STEP = 5;

export interface ResizableHandleProps extends HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement> {
  /** Show a small grip so the divider is easy to find and hit. Default `false`. */
  withHandle?: boolean;
  /** Accessible name. Default "Resize panels". */
  'aria-label'?: string;
}

/**
 * The divider between two `ResizablePanel`s (it must sit directly between them). A WAI-ARIA window
 * splitter: drag it, or focus it and use the arrow keys (±5%), Home / End (to the limits) and Enter
 * (collapse or restore a collapsible neighbour).
 */
export const ResizableHandle = forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, ResizableHandleProps>(function ResizableHandle(
  { withHandle = false, className, onKeyDown, 'aria-label': label = 'Resize panels', children, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  const api = useResizableContext('ResizableHandle');
  const elRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const setRef = useComposedRefs(ref, elRef);
  const drag = useRef<{ pointerId: number; start: number; session: DragSession; prev: string; next: string } | null>(null);
  const [info, setInfo] = useState<(HandleInfo & { controls: string }) | null>(null);
  const horizontal = api.direction === 'horizontal';

  /** Ids of the panels on either side, read from the DOM so panels can be wrapped or reordered. */
  const neighbours = (): [string, string] | null => {
    const el = elRef.current;
    const prev = el?.previousElementSibling?.getAttribute('data-panel-id');
    const next = el?.nextElementSibling?.getAttribute('data-panel-id');
    return prev && next ? [prev, next] : null;
  };

  // Keep aria-valuenow / min / max in step with the layout
  useIsomorphicLayoutEffect(() => {
    const nb = neighbours();
    const d = nb ? api.describe(nb[0], nb[1]) : null;
    setInfo((old) => {
      if (!nb || !d) return old === null ? old : null;
      if (old && old.now === d.now && old.min === d.min && old.max === d.max && old.controls === nb[0]) return old;
      return { ...d, controls: nb[0] };
    });
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [api]);

  const onPointerDown = (e: PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    if (e.button > 0) return;
    const nb = neighbours();
    if (!nb) return;
    const session = api.beginDrag(nb[0], nb[1]);
    if (!session) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    e.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
    e.currentTarget.focus({ preventScroll: true });
    drag.current = { pointerId: e.pointerId, start: horizontal ? e.clientX : e.clientY, session, prev: nb[0], next: nb[1] };
  };

  const onPointerMove = (e: PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    const d = drag.current;
    if (!d || d.pointerId !== e.pointerId || d.session.pixels <= 0) return;
    const delta = ((horizontal ? e.clientX : e.clientY) - d.start) / d.session.pixels;
    api.dragTo(d.session, delta * 100);
  };

  const endDrag = (e: PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    if (drag.current?.pointerId !== e.pointerId) return;
    drag.current = null;
    api.endDrag();
  };

  const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    onKeyDown?.(e);
    if (e.defaultPrevented || e.altKey || e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) return;
    const nb = neighbours();
    if (!nb) return;
    const less = horizontal ? 'ArrowLeft' : 'ArrowUp';
    const more = horizontal ? 'ArrowRight' : 'ArrowDown';
    if (e.key === less) api.nudge(nb[0], nb[1], -STEP);
    else if (e.key === more) api.nudge(nb[0], nb[1], STEP);
    else if (e.key === 'Home') api.moveToEdge(nb[0], nb[1], 'start');
    else if (e.key === 'End') api.moveToEdge(nb[0], nb[1], 'end');
    else if (e.key === 'Enter') api.toggleCollapse(nb[0], nb[1]);
    else return;
    e.preventDefault();
  };

  return (
    <div
      ref={setRef}
      role="separator"
      tabIndex={0}
      aria-label={label}
      aria-orientation={horizontal ? 'vertical' : 'horizontal'}
      aria-valuenow={info?.now ?? 50}
      aria-valuemin={info?.min ?? 0}
      aria-valuemax={info?.max ?? 100}
      aria-controls={info?.controls}
      className={cn('ui-resizable-handle', className)}
      data-direction={api.direction}
      data-dragging={api.dragging || undefined}
      onPointerDown={onPointerDown}
      onPointerMove={onPointerMove}
      onPointerUp={endDrag}
      onPointerCancel={endDrag}
      onKeyDown={handleKeyDown}
      {...props}
    >
      {withHandle && (
        <span className="ui-resizable-grip" aria-hidden="true">
          <Icon name="grip-vertical" size={12} />
        </span>
      )}
      {children}
    </div>
  );
});
```

### `ui/components/resizable/resizable.tsx`

```tsx
'use client';

import { forwardRef, useEffect, useId, useRef, type CSSProperties, type HTMLAttributes } from 'react';
import { cn } from '../../lib/cn';
import { useComposedRefs } from '../../lib/compose-refs';
import { useIsomorphicLayoutEffect } from '../../hooks/use-isomorphic-layout-effect';
import { isCollapsed } from './layout';
import { ResizableContext, useResizableContext, useResizableGroup, type PanelInfo, type ResizableDirection } from './use-resizable-group';

export interface ResizablePanelGroupProps extends HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement> {
  /** `horizontal`: panels side by side. `vertical`: stacked. Default `horizontal`. */
  direction?: ResizableDirection;
  /**
   * Saves the layout in `localStorage` under this id (when set) and restores it on the next visit.
   * Unset: nothing is stored. Storage errors are ignored. Give the group a size (a height at least).
   */
  id?: string;
  /** Called with every panel's size in % (in document order) when a drag or key press ends. */
  onLayout?: (sizes: number[]) => void;
}

/**
 * ResizablePanelGroup — panels separated by draggable, keyboard-operable dividers.
 * Compose: ResizablePanel, ResizableHandle, ResizablePanel… (handles sit between two panels).
 * Sizes are percentages of the group; the group fills its parent, so give it a height.
 */
export const ResizablePanelGroup = forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, ResizablePanelGroupProps>(function ResizablePanelGroup(
  { direction = 'horizontal', id, onLayout, className, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  const api = useResizableGroup({ direction, id, onLayout });
  return (
    <ResizableContext.Provider value={api}>
      <div
        ref={ref}
        id={id}
        role="group"
        className={cn('ui-resizable-group', className)}
        data-direction={direction}
        data-dragging={api.dragging || undefined}
        data-snapping={api.snapping || undefined}
        {...props}
      />
    </ResizableContext.Provider>
  );
});

export interface ResizablePanelProps extends HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement> {
  /** Starting size in % of the group. Panels without one share what is left. */
  defaultSize?: number;
  /** Smallest size in %. Default 0. */
  minSize?: number;
  /** Largest size in %. Default 100. */
  maxSize?: number;
  /** Dragging below half of `minSize` snaps the panel shut; Enter on its handle toggles it. Default `false`. */
  collapsible?: boolean;
  /** Size in % when collapsed. Default 0. */
  collapsedSize?: number;
  /** Called with the panel's size in % when it changes. */
  onResize?: (size: number) => void;
}

/** One pane. Has `overflow: hidden`; put a `ScrollArea` inside for scrolling content. */
export const ResizablePanel = forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, ResizablePanelProps>(function ResizablePanel(
  { id: idProp, defaultSize, minSize = 0, maxSize = 100, collapsible = false, collapsedSize = 0, onResize, className, style, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  const api = useResizableContext('ResizablePanel');
  const autoId = useId();
  const id = idProp ?? autoId;
  const elRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const setRef = useComposedRefs(ref, elRef);
  // Constraints are read lazily, so changing a prop never re-registers the panel (which would reset the layout)
  const infoRef = useRef<PanelInfo>({ id, el: null, min: minSize, max: maxSize, collapsible, collapsedSize, defaultSize });
  infoRef.current = { id, el: elRef.current, min: minSize, max: maxSize, collapsible, collapsedSize, defaultSize };
  const { register } = api;
  useIsomorphicLayoutEffect(
    () => register(id, () => ({ ...infoRef.current, el: elRef.current })),
    [register, id],
  );

  const size = api.sizes[id] ?? defaultSize;
  const onResizeRef = useRef(onResize);
  onResizeRef.current = onResize;
  useEffect(() => {
    if (size !== undefined) onResizeRef.current?.(size);
  }, [size]);

  const collapsed = size !== undefined && isCollapsed({ min: minSize, max: maxSize, collapsible, collapsedSize }, size);
  return (
    <div
      ref={setRef}
      id={id}
      className={cn('ui-resizable-panel', className)}
      data-panel-id={id}
      data-collapsed={collapsed || undefined}
      style={{ ...style, flex: `${size ?? 1} 1 0px` } as CSSProperties}
      {...props}
    />
  );
});
```

### `ui/components/resizable/use-resizable-group.ts`

```ts
'use client';

import { createContext, useCallback, useContext, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { useIsomorphicLayoutEffect } from '../../hooks/use-isomorphic-layout-effect';
import { isCollapsed, isValidLayout, normalizeLayout, resizePair, round, type PanelConstraints } from './layout';

export type ResizableDirection = 'horizontal' | 'vertical';

export interface PanelInfo extends PanelConstraints {
  id: string;
  el: HTMLElement | null;
  defaultSize?: number;
}

export interface DragSession {
  index: number;
  /** Layout when the drag started; every move is computed from it. */
  layout: number[];
  /** Pixel size of all panels together (the space the percentages share). */
  pixels: number;
}

export interface HandleInfo {
  now: number;
  min: number;
  max: number;
}

export interface ResizableApi {
  direction: ResizableDirection;
  sizes: Record<string, number>;
  dragging: boolean;
  register: (id: string, get: () => PanelInfo) => () => void;
  beginDrag: (prevId: string, nextId: string) => DragSession | null;
  dragTo: (session: DragSession, deltaPercent: number) => void;
  endDrag: () => void;
  /** Move the divider by `delta` percentage points and save. */
  nudge: (prevId: string, nextId: string, delta: number) => void;
  /** Move the divider as far as the panels allow. */
  moveToEdge: (prevId: string, nextId: string, edge: 'start' | 'end') => void;
  /** Collapse the collapsible neighbour, or restore it if it is collapsed. */
  toggleCollapse: (prevId: string, nextId: string) => void;
  describe: (prevId: string, nextId: string) => HandleInfo | null;
}

export const ResizableContext = createContext<ResizableApi | null>(null);

export function useResizableContext(part: string): ResizableApi {
  const api = useContext(ResizableContext);
  if (!api) throw new Error(`<${part}> must be used inside <ResizablePanelGroup>`);
  return api;
}

const STORAGE_PREFIX = 'ui-resizable:';

export function useResizableGroup({
  direction,
  id,
  onLayout,
}: {
  direction: ResizableDirection;
  id?: string;
  onLayout?: (sizes: number[]) => void;
}): ResizableApi & { snapping: boolean } {
  const panels = useRef(new Map<string, () => PanelInfo>());
  const mounted = useRef(false);
  const [version, setVersion] = useState(0);
  const [sizes, setSizes] = useState<Record<string, number>>({});
  const [dragging, setDragging] = useState(false);
  const [snapping, setSnapping] = useState(false);
  const layoutRef = useRef<Record<string, number>>({});
  /** Size a collapsed panel returns to. */
  const restoreSize = useRef<Record<string, number>>({});
  const snapTimer = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined>(undefined);
  const idRef = useRef(id);
  idRef.current = id;
  const onLayoutRef = useRef(onLayout);
  onLayoutRef.current = onLayout;

  useEffect(() => () => clearTimeout(snapTimer.current), []);

  /** Panels in document order. */
  const ordered = useCallback((): PanelInfo[] => {
    const list = Array.from(panels.current.values(), (get) => get());
    return list.sort((a, b) => {
      if (!a.el || !b.el) return 0;
      return a.el.compareDocumentPosition(b.el) & Node.DOCUMENT_POSITION_FOLLOWING ? -1 : 1;
    });
  }, []);

  const current = useCallback((infos: PanelInfo[]) => infos.map((p) => layoutRef.current[p.id] ?? 0), []);

  const apply = useCallback((infos: PanelInfo[], layout: number[]) => {
    const map: Record<string, number> = {};
    infos.forEach((p, i) => {
      map[p.id] = layout[i]!;
    });
    layoutRef.current = map;
    setSizes(map);
  }, []);

  /** Persist (only when the group has an id) and report. Called when an interaction ends. */
  const commit = useCallback(() => {
    const layout = current(ordered()).map(round);
    if (idRef.current) {
      try {
        localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_PREFIX + idRef.current, JSON.stringify(layout));
      } catch {
        /* storage blocked or full: sizes just don't persist */
      }
    }
    onLayoutRef.current?.(layout);
  }, [current, ordered]);

  // Initial layout: saved one if valid, else the panels' default sizes. Re-runs when panels are added or removed.
  useIsomorphicLayoutEffect(() => {
    mounted.current = true;
    const infos = ordered();
    if (!infos.length) return;
    let layout: number[] | null = null;
    if (idRef.current) {
      try {
        const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_PREFIX + idRef.current);
        const parsed: unknown = raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : null;
        if (isValidLayout(parsed, infos.length)) layout = parsed;
      } catch {
        /* ignore */
      }
    }
    apply(infos, layout ?? normalizeLayout(infos.map((p) => p.defaultSize)));
  }, [version, ordered, apply]);

  const register = useCallback((panelId: string, get: () => PanelInfo) => {
    panels.current.set(panelId, get);
    if (mounted.current) setVersion((v) => v + 1);
    return () => {
      panels.current.delete(panelId);
      if (mounted.current) setVersion((v) => v + 1);
    };
  }, []);

  const pair = useCallback(
    (prevId: string, nextId: string) => {
      const infos = ordered();
      const index = infos.findIndex((p) => p.id === prevId);
      if (index < 0 || infos[index + 1]?.id !== nextId) return null;
      return { infos, index, layout: current(infos) };
    },
    [ordered, current],
  );

  const beginDrag = useCallback(
    (prevId: string, nextId: string): DragSession | null => {
      const p = pair(prevId, nextId);
      if (!p) return null;
      const pixels = p.infos.reduce((sum, info) => {
        const rect = info.el?.getBoundingClientRect();
        return sum + (rect ? (direction === 'horizontal' ? rect.width : rect.height) : 0);
      }, 0);
      setDragging(true);
      return { index: p.index, layout: p.layout, pixels };
    },
    [pair, direction],
  );

  const dragTo = useCallback(
    (session: DragSession, deltaPercent: number) => {
      const infos = ordered();
      apply(infos, resizePair(session.layout, infos, session.index, deltaPercent));
    },
    [ordered, apply],
  );

  const endDrag = useCallback(() => {
    setDragging(false);
    commit();
  }, [commit]);

  const nudge = useCallback(
    (prevId: string, nextId: string, delta: number) => {
      const p = pair(prevId, nextId);
      if (!p) return;
      apply(p.infos, resizePair(p.layout, p.infos, p.index, delta));
      commit();
    },
    [pair, apply, commit],
  );

  const describe = useCallback(
    (prevId: string, nextId: string): HandleInfo | null => {
      const p = pair(prevId, nextId);
      if (!p) return null;
      const a = p.infos[p.index]!;
      const b = p.infos[p.index + 1]!;
      const total = p.layout[p.index]! + p.layout[p.index + 1]!;
      const min = Math.max(a.collapsible ? a.collapsedSize : a.min, total - b.max);
      const max = Math.min(a.max, total - (b.collapsible ? b.collapsedSize : b.min));
      return { now: round(p.layout[p.index]!), min: round(min), max: round(Math.max(min, max)) };
    },
    [pair],
  );

  const moveToEdge = useCallback(
    (prevId: string, nextId: string, edge: 'start' | 'end') => {
      const info = describe(prevId, nextId);
      if (info) nudge(prevId, nextId, (edge === 'start' ? info.min : info.max) - info.now);
    },
    [describe, nudge],
  );

  const toggleCollapse = useCallback(
    (prevId: string, nextId: string) => {
      const p = pair(prevId, nextId);
      if (!p) return;
      const a = p.infos[p.index]!;
      const b = p.infos[p.index + 1]!;
      const sizeA = p.layout[p.index]!;
      const sizeB = p.layout[p.index + 1]!;
      const total = sizeA + sizeB;
      let wantA: number | null = null;
      if (a.collapsible) {
        if (isCollapsed(a, sizeA)) wantA = restoreSize.current[a.id] ?? a.min;
        else {
          restoreSize.current[a.id] = sizeA;
          wantA = a.collapsedSize;
        }
      } else if (b.collapsible) {
        if (isCollapsed(b, sizeB)) wantA = total - (restoreSize.current[b.id] ?? b.min);
        else {
          restoreSize.current[b.id] = sizeB;
          wantA = total - b.collapsedSize;
        }
      }
      if (wantA === null) return;
      setSnapping(true);
      clearTimeout(snapTimer.current);
      snapTimer.current = setTimeout(() => setSnapping(false), 700);
      apply(p.infos, resizePair(p.layout, p.infos, p.index, wantA - sizeA));
      commit();
    },
    [pair, apply, commit],
  );

  const api = useMemo(
    () => ({ direction, sizes, dragging, snapping, register, beginDrag, dragTo, endDrag, nudge, moveToEdge, toggleCollapse, describe }),
    [direction, sizes, dragging, snapping, register, beginDrag, dragTo, endDrag, nudge, moveToEdge, toggleCollapse, describe],
  );
  return api;
}
```

### `ui/hooks/use-isomorphic-layout-effect.ts`

```ts
'use client';

import { useEffect, useLayoutEffect } from 'react';

/** useLayoutEffect in the browser, useEffect on the server (no SSR warning). */
export const useIsomorphicLayoutEffect = typeof window !== 'undefined' ? useLayoutEffect : useEffect;
```

### `ui/icons/icon.tsx`

```tsx
import { forwardRef, type SVGProps } from 'react';
import { cn } from '../lib/cn';
import { iconPaths, type IconName } from './paths';

export interface IconProps extends Omit<SVGProps<SVGSVGElement>, 'ref'> {
  /** Icon shape. */
  name: IconName;
  /** Pixel size (width and height). Default 16. */
  size?: number | string;
  /** Stroke width. Default 1.75. */
  strokeWidth?: number;
  /** Accessible label. Without it the icon is decorative (aria-hidden). */
  label?: string;
}

/**
 * Built-in stroke icon. Inherits `currentColor`.
 *   <Icon name="check" />   <Icon name="search" size={20} label="Search" />
 * Server Component–safe.
 */
export const Icon = forwardRef<SVGSVGElement, IconProps>(function Icon(
  { name, size = 16, strokeWidth = 1.75, label, className, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  return (
    <svg
      ref={ref}
      xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
      viewBox="0 0 24 24"
      width={size}
      height={size}
      fill="none"
      stroke="currentColor"
      strokeWidth={strokeWidth}
      strokeLinecap="round"
      strokeLinejoin="round"
      aria-hidden={label ? undefined : true}
      aria-label={label}
      role={label ? 'img' : undefined}
      focusable="false"
      className={cn('ui-icon', className)}
      // Static, library-owned SVG markup — never user input.
      dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: iconPaths[name] }}
      {...props}
    />
  );
});

export { iconPaths, type IconName };
```

### `ui/lib/cn.ts`

```ts
/**
 * Join class names, skipping falsy values.
 * No tailwind-merge needed: ui-* classes live in Tailwind's `components`
 * layer, so any utility passed in `className` already wins.
 */
export type ClassValue = string | number | false | null | undefined;

export function cn(...classes: ClassValue[]): string {
  let out = '';
  for (const c of classes) {
    if (!c) continue;
    out = out ? `${out} ${c}` : String(c);
  }
  return out;
}
```

### `ui/lib/compose-refs.ts`

```ts
import { useCallback, type Ref, type RefCallback } from 'react';

type PossibleRef<T> = Ref<T> | undefined;

function setRef<T>(ref: PossibleRef<T>, value: T | null) {
  if (typeof ref === 'function') ref(value);
  else if (ref) (ref as { current: T | null }).current = value;
}

/** Merge several refs into one callback ref. */
export function composeRefs<T>(...refs: PossibleRef<T>[]): RefCallback<T> {
  return (node) => {
    for (const ref of refs) setRef(ref, node);
  };
}

/** Memoised composeRefs for use inside components. */
export function useComposedRefs<T>(...refs: PossibleRef<T>[]): RefCallback<T> {
  // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  return useCallback(composeRefs(...refs), refs);
}
```

### `ui/styles/components/resizable.css`

```css
/* Resizable panels --------------------------------------------------------
   .ui-resizable-group[data-direction="horizontal|vertical"][data-dragging][data-snapping]
     > .ui-resizable-panel[data-collapsed]   (flex: <size> 1 0px, set inline in %)
     > .ui-resizable-handle[role=separator] (> .ui-resizable-grip)
   The handle is a 1px line with an 8px-wide invisible hit area; it thickens on
   hover, focus and drag. Panels have overflow hidden; nest a ScrollArea inside.
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------ */

@layer components {
  .ui-resizable-group {
    display: flex;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    min-width: 0;
    min-height: 0;
  }
  .ui-resizable-group[data-direction="vertical"] { flex-direction: column; }
  .ui-resizable-group[data-dragging] { user-select: none; }
  .ui-resizable-group[data-dragging][data-direction="horizontal"] { cursor: col-resize; }
  .ui-resizable-group[data-dragging][data-direction="vertical"] { cursor: row-resize; }

  .ui-resizable-panel {
    min-width: 0;
    min-height: 0;
    overflow: hidden;
  }
  /* Keyboard collapse and restore glide; dragging follows the pointer with no easing */
  .ui-resizable-group[data-snapping]:not([data-dragging]) > .ui-resizable-panel {
    transition: flex-grow var(--ui-spring-smooth-duration) var(--ui-spring-smooth);
  }

  .ui-resizable-handle {
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
    display: flex;
    flex: 0 0 1px;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    background-color: var(--ui-border);
    outline: none;
    touch-action: none;
    -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
    transition: background-color var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard);
  }
  .ui-resizable-handle[data-direction="horizontal"] { cursor: col-resize; }
  .ui-resizable-handle[data-direction="vertical"] { cursor: row-resize; }

  /* Wider hit area than the visible line (24px on touch) */
  .ui-resizable-handle::after { content: ""; position: absolute; }
  .ui-resizable-handle[data-direction="horizontal"]::after { inset-block: 0; inset-inline: -4px; }
  .ui-resizable-handle[data-direction="vertical"]::after { inset-inline: 0; inset-block: -4px; }
  @media (pointer: coarse) {
    .ui-resizable-handle[data-direction="horizontal"]::after { inset-inline: -12px; }
    .ui-resizable-handle[data-direction="vertical"]::after { inset-block: -12px; }
  }

  /* The line thickens by painting a wider shadow, so panels never shift */
  .ui-resizable-handle[data-dragging],
  .ui-resizable-handle:focus-visible { background-color: var(--ui-ring); }
  .ui-resizable-handle[data-direction="horizontal"][data-dragging],
  .ui-resizable-handle[data-direction="horizontal"]:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--ui-ring); }
  .ui-resizable-handle[data-direction="vertical"][data-dragging],
  .ui-resizable-handle[data-direction="vertical"]:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--ui-ring); }
  @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
    .ui-resizable-handle:hover { background-color: var(--ui-border-strong); }
    .ui-resizable-handle[data-dragging]:hover { background-color: var(--ui-ring); }
  }

  .ui-resizable-grip {
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    width: 0.875rem;
    height: 1.5rem;
    border: 1px solid var(--ui-border);
    border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
    background-color: var(--ui-surface-raised);
    color: var(--ui-muted-foreground);
    pointer-events: none;
  }
  .ui-resizable-handle[data-direction="vertical"] .ui-resizable-grip { width: 1.5rem; height: 0.875rem; }
  .ui-resizable-handle[data-direction="vertical"] .ui-resizable-grip > svg { transform: rotate(90deg); }
}
```

## Usage

**Mail client** — from the docs (`apps/docs/examples/resizable/mail-client.tsx`), imports rewritten to `@/ui/...`:

```tsx
import { Avatar, AvatarFallback } from '@/ui/components/avatar';
import { Badge } from '@/ui/components/badge';
import { Item, ItemContent, ItemDescription, ItemMedia, ItemMeta, ItemTitle } from '@/ui/components/item';
import { ResizableHandle, ResizablePanel, ResizablePanelGroup } from '@/ui/components/resizable';
import { ScrollArea } from '@/ui/components/scroll-area';
import { Icon } from '@/ui/icons/icon';

const folders = [
  { name: 'Inbox', icon: 'inbox', count: 12 },
  { name: 'Starred', icon: 'star', count: 0 },
  { name: 'Sent', icon: 'mail', count: 0 },
  { name: 'Trash', icon: 'trash', count: 0 },
] as const;

const messages = [
  { from: 'Amina Rahman', initials: 'AR', subject: 'Q4 budget review', preview: 'Attached the revised figures. Can we go through marketing spend on Thursday?', time: '9:41 am', unread: true },
  { from: 'Tomás Herrera', initials: 'TH', subject: 'Deploy window tonight', preview: 'We are clear to ship at 22:00 UTC if QA signs off on the billing fix.', time: '8:15 am', unread: true },
  { from: 'Priya Nair', initials: 'PN', subject: 'Customer escalation: Fernhill', preview: 'They need an answer on the export bug before their board meeting on Friday.', time: 'Yesterday', unread: false },
  { from: 'Lena Kowalski', initials: 'LK', subject: 'Warehouse count mismatch', preview: 'Stock on hand differs by 14 units from the system. Recount scheduled for tomorrow.', time: 'Yesterday', unread: false },
  { from: 'Marcus Webb', initials: 'MW', subject: 'Partnership intro', preview: 'Great meeting you last week. Looping in our head of partnerships to continue the chat.', time: 'Mon', unread: false },
  { from: 'Design team', initials: 'DT', subject: 'New icon set ready', preview: 'The 1.75px stroke set is merged. Please review the empty states before release.', time: 'Mon', unread: false },
];

export default function ResizableMailClient() {
  return (
    <ResizablePanelGroup id="docs-mail-client" className="h-[30rem] w-full overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-border bg-card">
      <ResizablePanel defaultSize={20} minSize={14} maxSize={30} collapsible className="hidden sm:block">
        <nav aria-label="Mail folders" className="flex h-full flex-col gap-1 p-2">
          {folders.map((f) => (
            <a
              key={f.name}
              href="#"
              className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-md px-2 py-1.5 text-sm font-medium text-foreground hover:bg-accent"
              aria-current={f.name === 'Inbox' ? 'page' : undefined}
            >
              <Icon name={f.icon} />
              <span className="flex-1 truncate">{f.name}</span>
              {f.count > 0 && <span className="text-xs tabular-nums text-muted-foreground">{f.count}</span>}
            </a>
          ))}
        </nav>
      </ResizablePanel>
      <ResizableHandle aria-label="Resize folders" className="hidden sm:flex" />
      <ResizablePanel defaultSize={36} minSize={25}>
        <ScrollArea className="h-full" label="Messages" viewportClassName="p-2">
          {messages.map((m) => (
            <Item key={m.subject} size="sm" asChild>
              <a href="#">
                <ItemMedia>
                  <Avatar size="sm">
                    <AvatarFallback>{m.initials}</AvatarFallback>
                  </Avatar>
                </ItemMedia>
                <ItemContent>
                  <ItemTitle className={m.unread ? 'font-semibold' : undefined}>{m.subject}</ItemTitle>
                  <ItemDescription>{m.preview}</ItemDescription>
                </ItemContent>
                <ItemMeta>{m.time}</ItemMeta>
              </a>
            </Item>
          ))}
        </ScrollArea>
      </ResizablePanel>
      <ResizableHandle withHandle aria-label="Resize message list" />
      <ResizablePanel defaultSize={44} minSize={25}>
        <ScrollArea className="h-full" label="Message" viewportClassName="p-5">
          <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
            <Avatar>
              <AvatarFallback>AR</AvatarFallback>
            </Avatar>
            <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
              <h3 className="text-md font-semibold tracking-tight">Q4 budget review</h3>
              <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Amina Rahman to you, 9:41 am</p>
            </div>
            <Badge variant="info" size="sm">
              Finance
            </Badge>
          </div>
          <div className="mt-5 space-y-3 text-sm">
            <p>Hi team,</p>
            <p>I attached the revised Q4 figures. Marketing spend is 8% over plan, mostly from the autumn campaign, and travel is 12% under.</p>
            <p>Can we go through the numbers on Thursday at 10:00? I would like to lock the budget before the board pack goes out on Friday.</p>
            <p>Thanks,<br />Amina</p>
          </div>
        </ScrollArea>
      </ResizablePanel>
    </ResizablePanelGroup>
  );
}
```
